name: Sea
author: Alex112300
description: Click at 28.6% to fall to the floor as the ball. Click at around 29.5% to switch gravity and fall to the ceiling as the mini ball. At 82.75% do a frame perfect to fall between the two sets of spikes. Click just before 88% to fall on the top of the platform so you can enter the portals (you can click later straight into the portals). Play as mini until the end (beware of the difficult mini wave spam at 94%).
